description: This file contains functions related to Lantiq systems, including determining the system type and setting up DSL interfaces and modems based on the system configuration.

methods.name: lantiq_is_vdsl_system
methods.description: Checks if the system is a VDSL system by inspecting /proc/cpuinfo.

methods.name: lantiq_setup_dsl_helper
methods.description: Sets up DSL helper configurations based on the system type and specified annex.
